git --no-replace-objects pack-objects --revs --stdout --no-reuse-delta --no-reuse-object > "$M/strip-history.pack" <<EOF_STRIP_BASE || fail "cannot export base history"
$BASE
EOF_STRIP_BASE

_strip_unreach=$(git --git-dir="$CWD/.git" fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs 2>/dev/null | grep -c -E '^(unreachable|dangling) commit ' || true)
[ "$_strip_unreach" -eq 0 ] || fail "unexpected future commits in clean git directory"

# Python: this project's wheels in the pip download cache.

    try:
        p = configparser.ConfigParser()
        p.read(os.path.join(root, "setup.cfg"))
        name = p.get("metadata", "name", fallback=None)
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        text = open(os.path.join(root, "setup.py"), errors="replace").read()
        m = re.search(r"name\s*=\s*[\"']([^\"']+)", text)
        if m:

    except OSError:
        pass

    sys.stdout.write(name.strip())

    _pbc_pip_off="PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=${PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR}"
  fi

      rm -rf -- "$_pbc_d" || fail "purge-build-caches@4 cannot purge on-disk pip cache $_pbc_d"
